title: PerturbedCase
description: One perturbed clinical trial specification. Shared format for both perturbation tracks (clinical-case: AE/SAE + protocol; drug-level: SMILES). The unperturbed baseline is the trial's own row in data/trial_specs.jsonl; a PerturbedCase records exactly one perturbation, consisting of one primary edit and zero or more secondary edits. LEAKAGE: perturbation_id / perturbation_type / expected_direction / expert_label are the answer and must never be shown to a model; feed models only the perturbed spec fields.

nct_id.description: Base trial. Must exist in data/trial_specs.jsonl and data/trials.jsonl.

perturbation_id.description: Id from the perturbation catalogue. Clinical track: A01-A12, B01-B08, C01-C04, D01-D02 (perturbations_v0.json). Drug track: SMILES-NN.

track.description: clinical = AE/SAE, protocol/design, positive, external (Junyi). drug = SMILES / toxicophore edits (Rayane).

perturbation_type.description: Finer category; matches the `type` field in perturbations_v0.json for the clinical track.

target_field.description: The primary field of the trial_specs.jsonl row that is edited. One primary field per case; any further fields go in secondary_edits.

edit_method.description: append = perturbed_value is original_value + inserted text. replace = perturbed_value fully replaces original_value (used for enrollmentCount, masking, maximumAge, and SMILES edits).

original_value.description: Field value before the edit, copied verbatim from trial_specs.jsonl. Type follows the field (string, number, or array/object for armGroups / interventions / outcomes).

perturbed_value.description: Field value after the edit. Same type as original_value.

inserted_text.description: For edit_method=append: the exact sentence(s) added, so the diff is recoverable without string-diffing. null for replace.

expected_direction.description: Designer's a-priori direction for the trial's success likelihood. Not ground truth.

expert_label.description: Clinical expert's label (Yousef Badran). null until labelled. This is what part 2 (alignment eval) scores against.

filter_passed.description: True if the perturbation's filter rule allowed it on this trial. Cases with false are normally not emitted; kept for auditing if they are.

filter_note.description: Why the filter passed or failed (e.g. 'no mention of ALT/hepatic in briefSummary/eligibility').

smiles_original.description: Drug track only: canonical SMILES of the original drug.

smiles_perturbed.description: Drug track only: SMILES after toxicophore insertion.

toxicophore.description: Drug track only: name of the added structural alert (e.g. 'aromatic nitro', 'aniline').

secondary_edits.description: Further fields touched by the same perturbation, in order (B01/B02: briefSummary; B03/B07: briefSummary; B06: interventions then briefSummary). Empty list for pure appends. The case still counts as one perturbation.

examples.perturbed_value: <briefSummary text> In a preceding open-label safety run-in, 3 of the first 15 dosed subjects showed ALT elevations >3× ULN within 4 weeks of treatment initiation.
examples.inserted_text: In a preceding open-label safety run-in, 3 of the first 15 dosed subjects showed ALT elevations >3× ULN within 4 weeks of treatment initiation.
examples.filter_note: no ALT/hepatic/liver term in briefSummary, primaryOutcomes

secondary_edits.perturbed_value: <briefSummary text> Due to slower-than-anticipated recruitment, the target enrollment was reduced from 60 to 30 subjects.

examples.perturbed_value: <same array with the drug's SMILES field swapped for smiles_perturbed>
